name: Release

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: write
  id-token: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
        with:
          version: 11.20.0
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: 24
          registry-url: https://registry.npmjs.org
          package-manager-cache: false
      - run: npm install --global npm@latest
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: pnpm run ci
      - name: Validate installed runtime
        run: pnpm runtime:prepare --staging "$RUNNER_TEMP/browser-control-stage" --install "$RUNNER_TEMP/browser-control-runtime"
      - uses: changesets/action@v2
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          publish-script: pnpm release
          pr-draft: always
          create-github-releases: true
          push-git-tags: true

name: Browser gauntlet

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  schedule:
    - cron: "23 5 * * *"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  extension-boundary:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
        with:
          version: 11.20.0
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: 22.19.0
          cache: pnpm
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: Install lockfile-matched Chromium
        run: pnpm exec playwright-core install --with-deps chromium
      - name: Fast real-extension regression lane
        if: github.event_name != 'schedule' && github.event_name != 'workflow_dispatch'
        env:
          GAUNTLET_CASE: snapshot-native-controls,snapshot-document-baseline,runtime-context-replay,cross-origin-payment-iframe,auth-redirect-handoff,sentinel-overlay-click
          GAUNTLET_ARTIFACT_DIR: ${{ runner.temp }}/browser-control-gauntlet
        run: pnpm gauntlet:isolated
      - name: Repeated hostile-page lane
        if: github.event_name == 'schedule' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
        env:
          GAUNTLET_REPEAT: 3
          GAUNTLET_TIMEOUT_MS: 1500000
          GAUNTLET_ARTIFACT_DIR: ${{ runner.temp }}/browser-control-gauntlet
        run: pnpm gauntlet:isolated
      - name: Retain first-attempt evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: browser-gauntlet-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          retention-days: 14
          if-no-files-found: warn
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/browser-control-gauntlet/**/report.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/browser-control-gauntlet/**/run.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/browser-control-gauntlet/**/environment.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/browser-control-gauntlet/**/*.log

  "name": "@opencode-ai/browser-control",
  "version": "0.8.4",
  "description": "Local browser driver for trusted agents: control your existing Chromium-family browser through a small extension and a local relay.",
  "license": "MIT",
  "packageManager": "pnpm@11.20.0",
  "engines": {
    "node": ">=22.19.0"
  },
  "repository": {
    "type": "git",
    "url": "git+https://github.com/anomalyco/browser-control.git"
  },
  "type": "module",
  "exports": {
    ".": {
      "types": "./dist/types/index.d.ts",
      "import": "./dist/index.js"
    },
    "./server": {
      "types": "./dist/types/opencode.d.ts",
      "import": "./dist/opencode.js"
    }
  },
  "files": [
    "dist",
    "extension/dist",
    "skills/browser-control/SKILL.md",
    "README.md",
    "LICENSE"
  ],
  "publishConfig": {
    "access": "public",
    "provenance": true
  },
  "bin": {
    "browser-control": "./dist/cli.js",
    "browser-control-mcp": "./dist/mcp.js"
  },
  "types": "./dist/types/index.d.ts",
  "scripts": {
    "audit:duplicates": "jscpd src extension/src --format typescript --min-lines 10 --min-tokens 100 --mode weak --reporters console --absolute --no-tips",
    "bench:recording": "tsx scripts/bench-recording.ts",
    "bench:recording-quality": "tsx scripts/bench-recording-quality.ts",
    "build:cli": "tsx scripts/build-cli.ts",
    "build": "pnpm build:cli && pnpm build:extension",
    "build:extension": "tsx scripts/build-extension.ts",
    "package:extension": "pnpm build:extension && tsx scripts/package-extension.ts",
    "changeset": "changeset",
    "check:locals": "tsc --noEmit --noUnusedLocals --noUnusedParameters",
    "check:unused": "knip",
    "ci": "pnpm check:locals && pnpm check:unused && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm package:extension",
    "prepack": "pnpm build",
    "release": "changeset publish",
    "runtime:prepare": "tsx scripts/runtime-install.ts prepare",
    "runtime:select": "tsx scripts/runtime-install.ts select",
    "runtime:check-lifecycle": "tsx scripts/check-runtime-lifecycle.ts",
    "smoke": "tsx scripts/smoke.ts",
    "gauntlet": "tsx scripts/gauntlet.ts",
    "gauntlet:isolated": "tsx scripts/gauntlet-isolated.ts",
    "smoke:snapshot": "tsx scripts/check-snapshot.ts",
    "repro:screenshot-zoom": "tsx scripts/check-screenshot-zoom.ts",
    "repro:page-preservation": "tsx scripts/check-page-preservation.ts",
    "typecheck": "tsc --noEmit",
    "test": "vitest run",
    "smoke:debugger-ownership": "pnpm build:extension && tsx scripts/check-debugger-ownership.ts"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@effect/platform-node": "4.0.1",
    "@effect/platform-node-shared": "4.0.1",
    "acorn": "^8.18.0",
    "effect": "4.0.1",
    "pixelmatch": "^7.2.0",
    "playwright-core": "^1.63.0",
    "pngjs": "^7.0.0",
    "ws": "^8.22.0"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@changesets/cli": "^3.0.3",
    "@types/chrome": "^0.3.4",
    "@types/node": "^26.6.4",
    "@types/pngjs": "^6.0.5",
    "@types/ws": "^8.18.2",
    "esbuild": "^0.28.2",
    "fflate": "^0.8.3",
    "jscpd": "^5.4.0",
    "knip": "^6.39.0",
    "tsx": "^4.23.15",
    "typescript": "^7.0.2",
    "vitest": "^5.0.3"
  }
}
